Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the facts, but I suppose that's fine. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision.
Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision occurred?
A: I was in Houston, Texas, heading through an intersection and tunring left onto a side street. I had my turn signal on
and I was going slowly because the light had just turned yellow.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle bfeore the impact?
A: Not clearly. I glanced at oncoming traffic, saw headlights, and started my turn. The next thing I knew, the other car
was coming through the intersection and hit the front psasenger side of my car.
Q: Were you able to stop or swerve before the impact?
A: No, there wasn't time. It happened in a second or two.
Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?
A: No. I was dazed for a moment but I stayed conscious. I did hit my left arm on the door frame and the steering
wheel.
Q: What injuries have you had since the collision?
A: My left wrist was fractured. I was taken to the hospital and they put it in a cast. I've had follow-up appointments and
I'm still wearing a splint most of the day.
Q: Have you seen a physician or specialist for the wrist?
A: Yes, an orthopedic doctor. He said I'll need physical therapy for several weeks.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision?
A: Only that I was following the rules and I'm trying to get back to normal. My car is still at the repair shop.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thanks.
</page>

- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
